text_block_list.text:
Having received amusement park tickets, I 
invited Trainer Kiryuin to come hang out.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
An amusement park! I wonder what kind of 
rides they have! I'll have to bring Meek 
along next time!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's an amusement park, after all. 
It's bound to be tons of fun!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
What ride should we go on first! The very 
first choice you make is super important, 
you know~.

...She seems even more energetic than 
usual, or rather, strangely hyperactive...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! Up on those rails way up high, 
there's a bicycle...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: The bicycle...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...If an Umamusume pedaled with all her 
might, maybe she could even fly...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, look at that! Look at that blue 
sky.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think that if we could run 
through the sky, we'd be faster than 
anyone else!?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This might just revolutionize our training 
up until now...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, look at that Ferris wheel! If an 
Umamusume spun it with her leg power, it'd 
be amazing—!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm full of energy! I haven't slept in 
about two days, but I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Trainer <username>!?

Taking the flustered Trainer Kiryuin by 
the hand, I pulled her back to the Academy 
without giving her a say...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for letting these tickets go 
to waste because of me.
choice_data_list: Why did you pull an all-nighter?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: That is...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
........Because I've been thinking about 
it constantly. ...About a new training 
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Meek! Could you be practicing on your own?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will draw up a menu for 
your independent practice right away—

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
........More importantly, please get some 
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
........Because the lack of sleep is my 
fault.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
N-No, Meek. My lack of sleep is solely due 
to my own poor self-management and 
shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Coming up with training plans is a 
Trainer's job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...If only I had more ability, I could 
have properly kept up with your growth—
choice_data_list:
Whenever you're troubled, let's think 
through it together!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Eh... B-But that is...
choice_data_list:
We're fellow Tracen Academy Trainers, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...You are right. Our job is to make them 
shine brighter than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. As fellow Trainers, 
I'm delighted we can help one another out!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, !

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
........Trainer. ...Please go to sleep 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, hold on. I just thought of a great 
training idea!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We rent out a circuit track, you see, and 
run alongside a racing car――
choice_data_list: Anyway, please get some rest for today.

text_block_list.text:
I managed to talk Trainer Kiryuin into 
taking a well-deserved rest.
